query:
UPDATE templates
                    SET folder_structure = $1,
                        default_files = $2,
                        metadata_schema = $3,
                        renderer = $4,
                        ui_config = $5,
                        module_config = $6,
                        updated_at = $7
                    WHERE template_key = $8
                      AND tenant_id = $9
                      AND system_template = true
